title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Jira MCP and fetch script were not used: Jira is unreachable from this environment, so the local snapshot .artifacts/RHAISTRAT-1527/rfe-snapshot.md is the source.
The RFE acceptance criteria have no IDs. AC-1 to AC-17 were assigned in document order in user-stories.json.
The persona catalog (knowledge/personas/catalog.yaml) is not present in this plugin install. Persona ids ai-engineer and platform-admin are descriptive.
Model names (qwen2.5-vl-7b-instruct, omni-audio-chat-7b, whisper-large-v3) are placeholders. Which RHOAI models support vision is an open SPIKE in the RFE.
Tag names image-inferencing and audio-asr are the RFE's proposed names, pending agreement with the model registry team.
The 10 MB size limit is the RFE's proposed default, pending PM confirmation.
Backend and non-visual criteria are not demonstrated by the prototype: AC-8, AC-11, AC-12, AC-13, AC-15, AC-16, and the axe-core scan in AC-17. Visible accessible labels are built in.
Out of scope and not prototyped: microphone capture, audio output, video, PDF as image, multiple images per conversation, and chat persistence.
The Playground's send action is a stub. The prototype shows end-states and does not call a model.
